status: Color-key and GPU XRGB preservation batch implemented; overall applicable Wine conformance remains incomplete.

dependencies.scope: Project-owned shipping and diagnostic preprocessing dependencies plus runtime compilation units and build/resource definitions; SDK/toolchain are recorded by version, not included in this project-source closure.

platformIsolation.scope: Accepted isolated CPU/PCI/VGA/Wasm baseline retained. All18 current D3D host project modules frozen and copied before this cohort, including concurrent committed NV shared-host additions. This does not certify newer concurrent main-checkout CPU/NV changes.

changes: Blt rejects simultaneous surface/override selectors and missing keys with INVALIDPARAMS before temporary key/palette wire state. Source/destination key validation completes before any temporary key command.

Real legacy1/2/3 Blt views read destination-key value from the source retained last destination key, while permission still requires a present destination key. Modern4/7 use destination value. Borrowed wire value is restored on success and failed emission, without mutating public arrays.

Removing a key clears the description fields while retaining the private last value needed by the legacy destination-key rule. GetColorKey still reports NOCOLORKEY and preserves output sentinels after removal.

D9WG1.10 adds a private DirectDraw XRGB storage flag; no existing payload layout changes. Native unused bytes survive actual GPU upload, keyed discard, exact copies, packed fill and readback, including cube uploads. Other D3D resources retain existing storage defaults.

Fixed/programmed XRGB texture samples supply alpha one with one texture fetch. Logical destination alpha blending remains opaque through the existing native target mask, independent of stored unused bytes. Converting raw XRGB to other formats/presentation ignores the unused byte; only matching raw XRGB copies retain it. Ordinary unflagged integer copies preserve their original exact-copy fast path. No CPU replacement of GPU pixel results and no unconditional CPU readback added.
